description: Links to the 2400-pixel scan of a Vogue Paris cover (or any page), for a print, a poster, a wallpaper or a mood board, plus a preview image and the credit line. Scans are given for issues from 1930 and earlier (US public domain); later issues get the reader link. Example questions: "high-res 1925 Vogue cover to print"; "download a vintage Vogue cover for a poster"; "Vogue cover wallpaper".

issue.description: An issue date ("1925-06-15"), a month ("1925-06", nearest issue that month) or a Gallica ark ("bpt6k9604118j")
